title: Add Compact Connection Minimap for Kit Diagram
description: Add a small compact map in the kit diagram to visualize all current relationships (type-design, port-type, type-type compatibility, hierarchy links) at a glance. Reuse existing diagram minimap styling/pattern used by design diagram.
summary: Reverted the previous Kit diagram minimap addition by removing `showMinimap` and `miniMapNodeComponent` props from KitDiagramInner. This restores the prior UI behavior with no in-canvas minimap.
